scope: Eight official faculty directories, plus the existing CSRankings Vanderbilt roster. Related clinical and neuroscience faculty enter through these cross-appointments and institute directories. This is a complete roster-screening pass within those sources, not an exhaustive audit of every Vanderbilt/VUMC department or every publication.
method: Resolve roster aliases; screen linked official profiles and research descriptions; inspect topic-specific lab, project and publication sources for positive decisions; verify current appointments for included people. Sparse profiles and unverified candidates remain explicitly unresolved. No faculty contacts or personal contact details are republished.

criteria.ts: Method development or explicit research in temporal/longitudinal sequences, forecasting, anomaly detection or spatiotemporal learning.
criteria.medts: Computational/statistical analysis of repeated clinical measurements, longitudinal biomedical data, physiological signals or temporal neuroimaging; includes basic neural signal research, not only patient data.
criteria.bci: Explicit brain-computer/brain-machine interface, neuroprosthetic brain control or neural decoding for an interface; EEG, stimulation and EMG alone do not qualify.
